regions.today: Any mist or fog will clear away quickly this morning to leave a dry day with sunny spells, turning hazy at times. Highest temperatures of 19 to 23 degrees in light, occasionally moderate east or southeast winds.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry tonight with clear spells and just the chance of an isolated shower in the south of the province. Temperatures will not fall below 11 to 15 degrees in light, occasionally moderate easterly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Rather cloudy tomorrow with limited sunny spells. Mostly dry for the morning with just occasional showers. From mid-afternoon, scattered showers will begin to move in from the south, reaching the north of the province in the evening. Highest temperatures of 19 to 23 degrees in light to moderate easterly winds.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate Monday. Low to moderate Tuesday.
